# QuickPitch

> QuickPitch is a minimalist video-pitch tool: the host shares a meeting code, the prospect joins in the browser, and the pitch is time-boxed to 20 minutes and 5 slides.

## Features
- Join a pitch with a meeting code, no install
- Real-time video meeting (Agora)
- Dashboard to upload and organise up to 5 pitch slides
- Built-in 20-minute timer and call history

## Links
- App: https://quickpitch.lovable.app/
